facts.fact: The CSEA policy brief of November 2025 states that the Ministry of Health relies on DHIS2, which it describes as a digital platform backed by international partners, to monitor health indicators, and that health data managed through DHIS2 remain isolated from education and social protection systems.

The CSEA brief (November 2025) states that weak rural connectivity forces local health centres to rely on manual reporting and paper-based records, and that in remote villages such as around Kankan community health workers' paper records are physically delivered or manually typed into simple spreadsheets at the district health office at the end of each month.
